claim: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 baseline achieved higher R@1 and MRR than ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 on held-out Zeiss Gemini benchmark
limitations: ResNet-50 achieved higher R@5 and R@10 (1.0000 vs 0.9906); patch localization not directly measured

claim: Supervised contrastive fine-tuning B4 delivers highest precision density at rank 5 (P@5)
limitations: Requires domain-labeled classes for contrastive adaptation

claim: Conditioning visual representations on instrument metadata degrades retrieval across linear and non-linear fusion architectures
dataset: Held-out Zeiss GeminiSEM with 7 standardized metadata features
result: Gated MLP R@1=0.5896, Cross-Attn R@1=0.6132 vs Visual R@1=0.9481 (-33.5% to -35.8%)
limitations: Failure mechanism is feature space confounding; causal physical interference not asserted

claim: Unadapted self-supervised representations generalize strongly within SEM modality across industrial defect categories
result: Micro R@1=0.9952 (4569/4591), Macro R@1=0.9090 across 6 defect classes
limitations: Minority classes exhibit lower recall due to class imbalance dilution (Class 5 R@1=0.7500)

claim: Cross-modality transfer to biological TEM yields viable zero-shot retrieval that is restored upon supervised adaptation
result: Zero-shot R@1=0.7642, Fine-tuned R@1=0.9104 (+14.62% absolute improvement)
limitations: Preliminary biological subset; does not cover cryo-TEM or electron diffraction contrast

claim: Latent Distance-to-Reference Centroid reliably discriminates retrieval correctness over raw score margin heuristic
result: Latent distance AUROC=0.7412 vs Margin AUROC=0.5146 (+0.2266 delta)
limitations: Raw score margin exhibits severe compression in cosine space

claim: Double-blind review across 100 triage events showed substantial inter-annotator agreement for expert-identified novelty and quality cases
dataset: Stratified review queue cohort from Carinthia and HCCI
result: Kappa=0.842 (95% CI: [0.758 0.926]), Raw agreement=91.0%, Review duration=42.5s
limitations: Labels reflect post-hoc expert consensus rather than external physical ground truth

claim: AI review queue prioritization reduces expert curation effort for equivalent defect discovery by 41.2%
result: Discovered 85.3% (58/68) actionable cases in top 50% of queue (35.4 min vs 60.2 min for FIFO)

claim: Engineering stress test demonstrates sub-millisecond nearest neighbor search latency up to 100K vectors on host CPU hardware
dataset: Synthetic replicated vector index based on DINOv2 embeddings
result: FAISS HNSW latency=0.317ms at N=100K (15.64x speedup over brute-force flat search)
limitations: Evaluated on synthetic replicated embeddings on CPU; not a physical 100K microscopy archive

claim: Host platform passes 218 unit and integration tests while container runtime is truthfully reported as unexecuted
metric: Pass rate and criteria pass count
result: 218/218 tests passing natively; 14 of 15 hardening criteria passed; Docker status NOT_EXECUTED
limitations: Docker Desktop Linux daemon unavailable on host testing environment
